title: Everyday Departure Check
description: Check the common leaving-home items before you go: heat tools, stove, windows, lights, keys, and the final lock.
goodFor: A clear leaving-home check with optional photos for items you want to review later.
steps: Hair tools: Unplug straighteners or curling iron and place them on a heat-safe surface. (Take a photo)
Stove and oven: Check that every dial is set to Off. (Take a photo)
Toaster: Unplug it or make sure the area around it is clear.
Sink: Turn off the water and check there is no drip or standing water.
Portable heaters: Unplug any portable heaters. (Take a photo)
Windows: Walk through each room and check the window latches.
Iron: If you used it, unplug it and stand it upright.
Lights: Switch off any lights that do not need to stay on.
Personal items: Pick up your keys, wallet, phone, and bag.
Front door: Lock it, test the handle, and take a photo of the locked door. (Take a photo)

title: Bedtime House Check
description: An evening pass for doors, windows, kitchen, alarms, pets, and phone charging.
steps: Back door or patio door: Check that the latch is fully closed. (Take a photo)
Ground-floor windows: Check any windows that are easy to miss, such as bathroom or utility windows.
Kitchen: Move towels away from the hob and check that the stove and oven are off.
Front door: Lock the door and put the chain on if you use one.
Pet water: Check that pets have water for the night.
Alarm: Set the house alarm or sensors if you use them.
Phone charge: Plug your phone in and check that it is charging.
Morning setup: Prepare the coffee machine or anything else you want ready.
Water check: Listen for running water in the bathroom or kitchen.
Front door photo: Take a photo of the locked front door from inside. (Take a photo)

title: Medication Check
description: A simple routine for checking medication before you mark it done.
goodFor: A personal medication check with a timestamped routine record.
steps: Medication: Go to the place where you keep it.
Water: Fill a glass of water.
Amount: Set out what you need to take now.
Photo check: Take a photo of the medication set out for this step. (Take a photo)
Take medication: Take it with the water.
Container: Close the lid tightly.
Refill check: Check whether you need to order more.
Record: Mark the step done straight away.

title: No Item Left Behind Hotel Checkout
description: Check the safe, bathroom, outlets, drawers, and key before you leave the room.
goodFor: A room checkout pass for chargers, documents, jewellery, and small items.
steps: Safe: Open it wide and check inside for passports, cash, jewellery, or cards. (Take a photo of the empty safe)
Shower: Check the ledge for toiletries, rings, or razors.
Outlets: Check every power outlet for phone or laptop chargers.
Under the bed: Use your phone light to check for small items.
Wardrobe: Move every hanger and check the back.
Bedside table: Open the drawer and check the back corner.
Towels: Gather used towels into one place so the floor is clear.
Bathroom: Check the sink, shelf, and medicine cabinet.
Key items: Check passport, wallet, and phone.
Room key: Take a photo of the room key before you return it. (Take a photo)

title: Essential School Morning Run
description: Check the school-day essentials before you leave.
goodFor: A morning packing check for bags, food, forms, devices, and weather items.
steps: School bag: Check that the main school bag is packed and by the door.
Lunch and water: Check that the lunchbox is packed and the water bottle is filled and sealed.
Extra bag: Check the calendar for PE, swimming, library books, or other extras.
Forms and folders: Check for signed forms, homework, or school folders.
Device: If they use a tablet or laptop, check that it is packed and charged.
Weather: Add a coat or umbrella if rain looks likely.
Shoes: Check that both shoes are found and on.
Your items: Pick up your own bag, keys, wallet, and phone.
Pet exit: If a pet is staying home, check the crate, gate, or room door.
Departure photo: Lock the door and take a photo as you leave. (Take a photo)

title: House Sitter Handover
description: Leave practical notes and photo checks for the home, pets, and key handover.
goodFor: A handover checklist for care details, supplies, and house state.
steps: Contact details: Leave a note with the vet number and a local contact. (Take a photo)
Thermostat: Set heating or cooling to the away setting.
Plants: Water plants or group them together for easier care.
Kitchen waste: Empty the kitchen waste so it is not left while you are away.
Fridge: Remove anything that will expire before you get back.
Mail: Tell the sitter where the mailbox key is or where to put mail.
Pet food: Show where the food and bowls are kept. (Take a photo)
Spare key: Check that the sitter has their copy and knows how the lock works.
Appliances: Unplug non-essential electronics such as TVs, blenders, or small kitchen appliances.
Room photo: Take a wide photo of the main room before you leave. (Take a photo)

title: Car Lock & Parking Check
description: Check the windows, lights, valuables, lock, parking spot, and keys.
goodFor: A car lock and parking check you can review later.
steps: Windows: Check that all windows are fully closed.
Brake: Apply the handbrake or electronic brake.
Lights: Check that internal lights are off and headlights are set to auto or off.
Valuables: Make sure bags, phones, and wallets are not visible on the seats.
Lock: Lock the car and check for the sound or light flash.
Parking spot: Take a photo of the car in its spot, with a useful marker in frame. (Take a photo)
Keys: Put your keys in the pocket or pouch you use for them.
Passenger seat: Check once more for sunglasses, water bottle, or small items.
Exit: Leave the car park or garage.

title: Big Trip Home Shutdown
description: Before a longer trip, check food, waste, water, temperature, electronics, plants, and doors.
goodFor: A home shutdown checklist for longer trips.
steps: Fridge: Throw away milk and open perishables that will expire.
Household waste: Empty household waste and take the bags outside. (Take a photo)
Dishwasher: Run it now or leave it empty; do not leave dirty dishes for the trip.
Water: If you usually turn off the main water, do it now. Otherwise check that the garden hose is off.
Thermostat: Set the house to its usual away temperature.
Electronics: Unplug the TV, toaster, microwave, and other small appliances. (Take a photo)
Plants: Water plants or group them together for easier care.
Curtains and blinds: Set them to your usual away position.
Final door check: Lock the back door and any side gates.
Departure photo: Take a photo of your keys in your travel bag as you close the front door. (Take a photo)

title: Morning Pet Routine
description: Check food, water, medication, gates, doors, and collar before you leave.
goodFor: A daily pet care routine with optional photos for food and water.
steps: Clean bowl: Rinse the food bowl.
Food: Add the usual meal.
Fresh water: Empty the water bowl and refill it. (Take a photo)
Medication: Give pet medication if needed.
Outside break: Let them out before you leave.
Toy or treat: Leave the toy or treat you usually use.
Rooms: Close any rooms they should not enter.
Collar: Check that the collar is on and secure.
Food and water photo: Take a photo of the water bowl and food dish. (Take a photo)

title: Office Switch-Off
description: Close the workday with a check of screens, heater, papers, windows, mug, notes, lights, and lock.
goodFor: A workspace closing checklist for equipment, papers, and personal items.
steps: Screens: Power down your monitors.
Desk heater: If you use a space heater, unplug it. (Take a photo)
Papers: Clear private documents and put them in a locked drawer.
Personal items: Check for laptop charger, glasses, keys, and phone.
Windows: If you opened a window, check that it is latched.
Mug: Take your mug to the kitchen or break room.
Tomorrow list: Write down the first task for tomorrow.
Lights: Switch off your desk lamp or the main office lights.
Lock: Lock your office door, drawer, or cabinet. (Take a photo of the key or locked door)

title: Toddler Essentials Bag
description: Check baby items, clothes, snacks, water, weather gear, keys, and stroller before you leave.
goodFor: A packing checklist for outings with a toddler.
steps: Baby items: Pack enough changing items and wipes for the trip.
Spare outfit: Pack a full change of clothes, including socks.
Snacks and water: Pack snacks and a sealed water cup.
Comfort item: Pack the toy or blanket they usually need. (Take a photo)
Changing mat: Put the portable mat in the side pocket.
Small bags: Add a few spare bags for wet or dirty items.
Weather items: Pack sunscreen and a hat, or warm layers if needed.
Your items: Put your keys, wallet, and phone in the bag you will carry.
Stroller: Check that the rain cover or sunshade is attached if needed.
Packed bag photo: Take a photo of the packed bag by the door. (Take a photo)

title: Gym & Sports Prep
description: Check shoes, kit, towel, headphones, lock, water, pass, and toiletries before you go.
goodFor: A packing checklist for gym and sports sessions.
steps: Shoes: Check that your trainers or sports shoes are in the bag.
Fresh kit: Pack clean clothing and socks.
Towel: Pack a towel if you need one.
Headphones: Check that headphones are packed and charged.
Lock: Check that you have your locker lock. (Take a photo)
Water: Fill your water bottle and check that the lid is tight.
Gym pass: Check that your pass, card, or phone app is ready.
After-session items: Pack deodorant and toiletries you need.
Bag photo: Take a photo of the open bag with shoes and towel visible. (Take a photo)
